_doc: Manual overrides applied by importer/lib/build.js. Every entry is reported in data/catalog/IMPORT-REPORT.md. Keep entries minimal and justified by the source text.

blockFixes.title: Pineal – Mama (D/I)
blockFixes.reason: The printed block title repeats '286. Parietal (D/I) – Riñón (Ipsilateral)'; the figure (Pineal / Mama (D/I)), its caption '288. Lactancia' and the index entry '288. Pineal – Mama (Lactancia)' show this block is pair 288.

154._why: Guide p.20 names it 'Par Especial Disfuncional Goiz'.

294._why: Text layer of the 'Relación' line is garbled ('t'); figure caption and index read 'Reservorio Bacterias'.

282._why: Four-magnet 'pancreatic belt'. The guide title is 'Páncreas – Páncreas – Páncreas – Páncreas'; the Leal compendium (p.335, Pancreatitis) specifies four magnets around the pancreas with alternating polarity (-,+,-,+) at head, body, tail and tip. tracking/impact keep the generic 'pancreas' point; `magnets` lists the four placements.
notes: Cinturón pancreático: 4 imanes alrededor del páncreas con polaridad alterna (−, +, −, +) en cabeza, cuerpo, cola y punta (Leal 2018, p.335).

113.title: Dorso – Lumbar
113._why: Printed block title reads 'Dorsal – Lumbar' but the figure label and the index (p.6) read 'Dorso – Lumbar'.

259.title: Estómago – Sacro
259._why: Block title and figure read 'Colon Transverso – Sacro', but the Level 2 index (p.147), the Level 1 'Top 10 Gastrointestinal' (p.107, item 7 'Estómago – Sacro') and the Leal compendium (Chlamydia Intestinalis: Estómago → Sacro) all give 'Estómago – Sacro'; the block appears to repeat pair 258 (Estómago – Colon Transverso).

300.title: Pospineal – Pospineal
300._why: Block title and figure repeat pair 299 ('Ombligo – Testículo (D/I)'); the index (p.146), the Level 2 psycho-emotional list (p.244) and the Leal compendium (Integridad Moral: Pospineal → Pospineal) give 'Pospineal – Pospineal'.

222._why: Block 'Relación' line reads 'Adenovirus 33' (duplicating pair 217); the Level 2 index (p.144: '222. Conducto Deferente – Laringe (VSH)') and the Leal compendium (VSH: Conducto Deferente → Laringe, p.463) both give VSH.

13._why: Both magnets go on the left temporal; the block's recommendation specifies 'Imán negativo adelante, imán positivo atrás' (negative anterior, positive posterior).

115._why: Block 'Relación' line reads 'Enterococcus Faecalis' (repeating pair 90); the figure caption, the index (p.8) and both alphabetical lists (p.124, p.129) read 'Rickettsia Prowazecki'.

253._why: Block 'Relación' line reads 'Campylobacter Jejuni' (repeating pair 247); the figure caption ('253. Listeria Monocytogenes (1)') and the index (p.146) read 'Listeria Monocytogenes'.

entityAliases._doc: Goiz relation name (slug) -> Leal compendium entity id, when both name the same organism/condition with different spelling.

categoryByPair._doc: Explicit categories where the source gives no section header and the automatic rules (see IMPORT-REPORT 'Category assignment') would be wrong. Level 2 index order: viruses 211-227, bacteria 228-259, parasites 260-270, fungi 271-273, special 274-322, then 323-325 added at the end.

notes: Rastreo dirigido a Pseudomona Aeruginosa, Proteus Mirabilis, Clostridium, E. Coli y Klebsiella
imán negativo adicional en Pineal (Pineal & Palma derecha)

diseaseNames._doc: Disease protocol names where the block heading has a typo and the Level 2 index (p.149–153) is correct.
